cohort: 244 women, 123 with a history of gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) and 121 without (non-GDM group).
finding: Women with a history of GDM had higher rates of exclusive breastfeeding at 6 months postpartum, but GDM history was not an independent predictor of exclusive breastfeeding success.
mod_finding: Exclusive breastfeeding for six months resulted in reduced weight gain during the first six months of life among offspring of women in both groups.
